guide: See README.md for the public protocol and input requirements.

training.attention: native Mistral v0.1 sliding_window=4096, Transformers 4.45.1 SDPA

base_table1_schedule_reason: The existing Meta-Llama-3-8B Base canonical four-cell matrix used the 128×4-domain Mix schedule; the Mistral extension follows that pre-existing comparison definition, before looking at Mistral test scores.
parent_policy: Base uses four existing v0.1 C4-fitted parents if structure and native attention checks pass. Instruct requires its own newly fitted v0.1 parent; Base, Instruct-v0.2 and 32-step pilot endpoints cannot substitute.
evaluation_policy: All trained endpoints and all fixed references use identical within-table inputs, masks, precision and scoring; no result-based selection, no seed dropping, no paper edits.
rate_policy: GSRQ1=16×8-bit residual indices over D128; GSRQ2=32×8-bit; CQ uses native contiguous groups and dynamic BPA from actual index count.
